{{Top|leg}}
A '''durability upgrade''' was a module that increased the survivability of a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] by the creation of redundant programs and by upgrading the self-repair software.

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 2 to be able to equip this item.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''
